reason: Mostly a repeat. The only new part has no value under the pre-registration. (1) Not new: submitting K1 (exp58t v1) in the next 26 Sep slot if K2 errors is round 1 item 6 (FINAL_REPORT_v4 §3, §5 OK item 4; WATCHLIST W20/W21). The RT1 feasibility verdict already proposed a conditional K1 trigger. The d1 <= -0.002 branch (R3 drops lowrefine, F1 must become K1) is already written as a pre-score rule in round3/scan_plancheck.json. (2) The one new element is widening the trigger to d1 = K2 - #35 = -0.001, and it buys nothing. By R3, a rider at -0.001 stays, so F1 = K2. §f lets a simpler file replace F1 only at >= +0.002. R7 forbids choosing between near-copies by 0.001. A scored K1 of 0.954 against K2 at 0.953 therefore cannot move F1 or F2 (F2 = the exp58n twin by f2) without rewriting R3 after the score, which is the post-hoc 0.001 pick the rules exist to stop. RT1's value skeptic already made this point. (3) The claimed 'tail insurance' does not exist once K2 is scored. Private is scored in the same hidden run as public, so a scored, R5-admissible K2 has no remaining tail for K1 to insure. The only real tails are a K2 error, d1 <= -0.002, and K2 failing R5 (L(K2) > 9.5 h). The first two are covered already, and the R5 case is the one piece worth adding. (4) The expected gain of +2e-5 to +5e-5 comes almost entirely from those covered worlds (P ~0.05-0.08, times the insertion's private value over a fallback to #34/exp52). The d1 = -0.001 world (P ~0.1-0.15) adds ~0. Feasibility is not the problem. K1 is built and gated (sha256 == exp57b dummy), it adds no mechanism (R8 is fine), its 9.5 h family covers L35 <= 7.73 h, the slots are free after T9, and it needs only the user's OK. The objection is value and rules, and the hypothesis is a duplicate.
fix: Do not add a separate R3S-7 item. Merge it into the existing morning OK line (round 1 item 6 plus the round 3 plancheck rule), written in CONTEXT before K2 scores: 'Submit K1 (exp58t v1 unchanged, message starting with exp58t) in the next free 26 Sep slot if K2 errors, OR d1 = K2 - #35 <= -0.002 (R3 drops lowrefine), OR K2 fails R5 (L(K2) > 9.5 h proven by the poller). Then F1 = K1 once it is scored without error and R5-admissible on its own latency, and F2 = exp52 while lowrefine is closed. At d1 = -0.001 hold K1: R3 keeps lowrefine, F1 = K2, F2 = the twin, and no 0.001 comparison between K1 and K2 is ever used.' Gate: the passed K1 dummy, plus R5 on K1's own latency.
realistic_gain: About +2e-5 to +4e-5 on private in expectation, already captured by round 1 item 6 and the round 3 plancheck rule (the K2 error, d1 <= -0.002 and K2 R5-fail worlds, P ~0.05-0.08). The d1 = -0.001 widening this finding adds is worth ~0: its score cannot change the finals under R3, R7 and §f, and it costs one otherwise free slot.
